annotations.title: Satellite before/after: two clearest Sentinel-2 scenes, images and NDVI change for any place

description: Use when checking what changed at a place between two dates (construction, deforestation, flooding, crops). Input: lat, lon, radius_m (200-10000), before and after dates (20+ days apart). Output: JSON per date: clearest scene, area cloud %, NDVI mean/median, true color, NDVI and false color PNG URLs; NDVI change and reliability. No scene: 404, not charged. Behavior: each date is matched to the clearest Sentinel-2 L2A scene within ±window_days (default 15) by cloud share inside your square, not the whole tile; dates under 20 days apart: 400, not charged. NDVI is not cloud-masked, so reliability=low when either scene is over 20% cloud in the area. PNG URLs are rendered on open by Microsoft Planetary Computer, not stored by us; scene statistics are cached 30 days. Can take several seconds. Use instead: satellite_image for one date or other bands (NDWI, moisture); satellite_trend for month-by-month numbers. Example: ?lat=37.5665&lon=126.978&before=2026-04-15&after=2026-10-08 Price: $0.018 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

after.description: Later date YYYY-MM-DD, at least 20 days after before

radius_m.description: Half-width of the square area in meters (default 2000)
